title: Mermail Inbox Canary — real diagnostic run
note: Each sentence has `say` (sent to TTS; phonetic spellings such as 'Mer mail' and 'identifier' were chosen after an ASR check) and `show` (caption text with exact identifiers). Facts must match src/evidence.json.

sentences.say: Before an agent hands out its email address for verification codes or receipts, it needs to know one thing.
sentences.show: Before an agent hands out its email address for verification codes or receipts, it needs to know one thing.

sentences.say: Does this mailbox actually deliver mail, end to end?
sentences.show: Does this mailbox actually deliver mail, end to end?

sentences.say: The Mer mail Inbox Canary skill answers that with one tagged probe, and a verdict grounded only in real tool results.
sentences.show: The Mermail Inbox Canary skill answers that with one tagged probe and a verdict grounded only in real tool results.

sentences.say: This is a real run against hosted Mer mail, and it shows what the skill does when the round trip cannot be verified.
sentences.show: This is a real run against hosted Mermail — and it shows what the skill does when the round trip cannot be verified.

sentences.say: The request it serves looks like this.
sentences.show: The request it serves looks like this:

sentences.say: Use Mer mail to prove my agent mailbox can send and receive mail, before I hand the address to a service.
sentences.show: “Use Mermail to prove my agent mailbox can send and receive mail before I hand the address to a service.”

sentences.say: The run used the real hosted Mer mail M C P server, through an authenticated session.
sentences.show: The run used the real hosted Mermail MCP server through an authenticated session.

sentences.say: The captured log shows server Mer mail, version one point oh point oh, the June eighteenth, twenty twenty-five protocol version, and a catalog of ninety-four tools.
sentences.show: Captured log: server mermail 1.0.0 · protocol 2025-06-18 · catalog: 94 tools.

sentences.say: Send email is present, which the probe needs. The agent inbox profile does not have it, so the skill never runs a canary there.
sentences.show: send_email is present, which the probe needs. The agent-inbox profile lacks it, so the skill never runs a canary there.

sentences.say: List workspaces and list mailboxes then resolved one ready owner inbox: token junkie labs, at Mer mail dot app.
sentences.show: list_workspaces + list_mailboxes resolved one ready owner inbox: tokenjunkielabs@mermail.app (public_id e48c62aa…).

sentences.say: Before anything is sent, the probe plan is journaled: a unique token, and the same mailbox as both sender and recipient.
sentences.show: Before anything is sent, the probe plan is journaled: a unique token, and the same mailbox as sender and recipient.

sentences.say: Planned send time: ten fifty-one, and twenty-five point five seconds, U T C.
sentences.show: planned_send_at 2026-10-07T10:51:25.521Z · token mc-20261007-fq450to1

sentences.say: Then, exactly one send email call, explicitly approved by the operator.
sentences.show: Then exactly one send_email call — approved via --approve-send by the operator.

sentences.say: The journal records the send one point three seconds after the planned time. The receipt says queued, and it could still be cancelled until ten fifty-one and thirty-eight seconds.
sentences.show: sent_at 10:51:26.827Z (+1.306 s after the plan) · id d1658608… · status queued · undo_until 10:51:38.363Z.

sentences.say: Everything in this video comes from that one recorded run. Nothing was sent again to make it.
sentences.show: Everything in this video comes from that one recorded run. Nothing was sent again to make it.

sentences.say: Next, the runner checks the receiving mailbox with bounded search emails reads: metadata only, held messages included.
sentences.show: Next, the runner checks the receiving mailbox with bounded search_emails reads: metadata only, held messages included.

sentences.say: The first read, five seconds after the send, returned one candidate.
sentences.show: First read, +5 s: candidates=1 total=1.

sentences.say: But a search hit is only a candidate. It still has to pass validation before it counts as an arrival.
sentences.show: But a search hit is only a candidate. It still has to pass validation before it counts as an arrival.

sentences.say: Here is the catch with a self probe. The token appears on two different messages: the copy that was sent, and the copy that is received.
sentences.show: Here is the catch with a self-probe: the token appears on two different messages — the copy that was sent, and the copy that is received.

sentences.say: Searching by token alone can surface both.
sentences.show: Searching by token alone can surface both.

sentences.say: Every recorded read returned the same single message. It carries the same identifier as the send receipt, and its folder is Sent.
sentences.show: Every recorded read returned the same single message: d1658608… — the send receipt’s own id, folder_id "sent".

sentences.say: Later reads, at ten fifty-two and at ten fifty-five, show it delivered, still in Sent, with a total count of one.
sentences.show: Reads at 10:52:50Z and 10:55:23Z: delivery_status "delivered", folder Sent, totalCount 1.

sentences.say: That proves the outgoing leg. It proves nothing about arrival.
sentences.show: That proves the outgoing leg. It proves nothing about arrival.

sentences.say: No distinct incoming copy was observed.
sentences.show: No distinct incoming copy was observed.

sentences.say: And this is exactly where the runner's first pass went wrong.
sentences.show: And this is exactly where the runner’s first pass went wrong.

sentences.say: Its log called that message the arrived probe. But the record says folder Sent, and delivery status queued.
sentences.show: Its log called it “the arrived probe” — but the record says folder_id "sent", delivery_status "queued".

sentences.say: It then reported degraded, with a six point five second round trip, taken from the message's date field. That is a record date, not a receipt.
sentences.show: It reported “degraded — round-trip 6.5s” from the date field: a record date, not a receipt.

sentences.say: That result is withdrawn, and it is never used as inbox proof.
sentences.show: That result is withdrawn, and it is never used as inbox proof.

sentences.say: The matching rule was then tightened. Now it rejects the send receipt's own identifier, the Sent and Outbox folders, and queued status. And it requires a distinct incoming copy.
sentences.show: The matcher was then tightened: it rejects the send receipt’s own id, Sent/Outbox folders and queued status, and requires a distinct incoming copy.

sentences.say: That repair has only been exercised on a synthetic case, so it is not presented as provider evidence.
sentences.show: That repair has only been exercised on a synthetic case, so it is not presented as provider evidence.

sentences.say: For this run: the token matches, but the identifier is the send receipt's own, and the folder is Sent.
sentences.show: For this run: the token matches, but the id is the send receipt’s own, and the folder is Sent.

sentences.say: Sender authentication reads unknown, with the reason: inbound provider unavailable. Scan status is null.
sentences.show: sender_authentication: unknown (reason: inbound_provider_unavailable) · scan_status: null.

sentences.say: Zero validating candidates, inside the bounded window.
sentences.show: Zero validating candidates inside the bounded window.

sentences.say: The authoritative record has three parts. Outgoing: delivered. Incoming: not observed. Round trip latency: not available.
sentences.show: Authoritative: OUTBOUND DELIVERED · INBOUND NOT OBSERVED · ROUND-TRIP LATENCY UNAVAILABLE.

sentences.say: In that record, the inbound message identifier is null, and the round trip latency is null.
sentences.show: In the record: inbound_message_id null · round_trip_latency null.

sentences.say: This is not a healthy result, and it is not reported as one.
sentences.show: This is not a healthy result, and it is not reported as one.

sentences.say: In the skill's own words: never claim the probe arrived on the basis of a send success, or a pending state.
sentences.show: In the skill’s own words: “Never claim the probe arrived on the basis of a send success or a pending state.”

sentences.say: The final report names the mailbox and its public identifier, the probe token, and the outgoing message identifier.
sentences.show: The final report names the mailbox and its public_id, the probe token, and the outgoing message id.

sentences.say: The skill never deletes or moves the probe automatically. Its identifier is reported, so the owner can handle it.
sentences.show: The skill never deletes or moves the probe automatically — its id is reported so the owner can handle it.

sentences.say: The stage that could not be verified is the receiving leg. Any recheck needs a fresh, approved probe. Never an automatic second send.
sentences.show: The stage that could not be verified is receive. Any re-check needs a fresh, approved probe — never an automatic resend.

sentences.say: The skill is open for review in pull request four nine eight, in the Nudgen Marketing, Mer mail skills repository.
sentences.show: The skill is open for review: github.com/Nudgen-Marketing/mermail-skills/pull/498
